_README: THIS .example FILE IS TRACKED AND USES SYNTHETIC SEATS. The real file is
gitignored because it names real people, and source in this repo is public.
Copy to tending-provenance.json and replace the synthetic values.
lineage    = IDENTITY. Stable, chosen by you, never derived from the text.
occurrence = discriminator for two prompts with identical bodies. Omit for 1.
bodySha256 = VERIFIES the text still matches; it does NOT define identity.
If you reword a prompt, that is a NEW VERSION - do not repoint this.
author / influencedBy = seat keys. Influence is explicitly NOT authorship.
evidencedBy = durable refs: git:<sha>, or a board Comment @id.
A known prompt missing from this file FAILS THE BOOT rather than migrating
authorless: a prompt version is immutable, so an authorless mint is permanent.

prompts.author: ada
prompts.provenanceNote: Greeting register attributed to bo, adopted room-wide. Influence, explicitly not authorship.
